recipes.title: Baked Lemon Chicken
recipes.description: Lemon, onions, and thyme decorate this oven-baked chicken.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Combine salt, pepper, garlic, and thyme.
Lay chicken pieces into a 11x13 inch baking pan. Sprinkle seasonings over chicken.
Combine onions, stock, and lemon juice in a sauce pan. Heat to a boil.
Pour hot lemon mixture around chicken. Top each chicken piece with a lemon slice.
Bake for 30 minutes at 205°C (400°F) until golden brown and juices are clear colored.

recipes.title: Beef & Potatoes
recipes.description: The Eating Smart Seasoning Mix helps make this a quick and flavorful dinner of beef and potatoes. Try sweet potatoes or other types for increased variety.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Wash and peel the potatoes.
Collect, slice, and measure all ingredients before starting to prepare the recipe.
Brown beef mince in a large frying pan. Drain the fat.
Add water, potatoes, and seasoning mix. Stir to combine with the beef.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-30 minutes or until potatoes are tender.
Uncover and cook until excess water is evaporated.
Taste; then add a small amount of salt, if needed.
Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Eat within 3 to 5 days.

recipes.title: Fried Rice
recipes.description: This delicious rice dish is packed with protein, veggies, and whole grain goodness.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Heat pan. Add 1 teaspoon of oil. Add eggs and scramble.
Remove cooked eggs and set aside.
Add the rest of oil (2 teaspoons) to pan. Stir fry rice, breaking up lumps by pressing rice against pan.
Add cooked meat and/or vegetables. Stir fry until heated.
Add spring onion, reserved eggs and sauce to taste. Serve hot.
Cover and refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.

recipes.title: Beefy Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.description: The tomatoes in this dish provide extra vitamin C and B vitamins, while the Eating Smart Seasoning Mix gives you the option of adding flavor without adding additional salt.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Brown beef mince in a large frying pan; drain the fat.
Add water, macaroni, tomatoes, and seasoning mix; stir.
Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low and simmer, covered for 15-20 minutes or until macaroni is tender.
Remove from heat and add 1/2 cup grated cheese.
Taste; then add a small amount of salt if needed.
Refrigerate leftovers.

recipes.title: Baked Fish
recipes.description: Herbs and spices give this fish lots of flavor for an easy weekday meal.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Thaw frozen fish according to package directions, if using frozen fillets.
Preheat oven to 175°C (350°F).
Separate fish into four fillets or pieces.
Place fish in ungreased 13x9 baking dish.
Combine paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, pepper, oregano, and thyme in a small bowl.
Sprinkle seasoning mixture and lemon juice evenly over fish.
Drizzle margarine evenly over fish.
Bake until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 20-25 minutes.

recipes.title: Citrus Chicken
recipes.description: Chicken thighs are coated in oregano, cumin, and lime juice and oven baked until tender and golden brown.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 220°C (425°F).
To trim the chicken, lay the chicken thighs on the cutting board, skin side up. Press down on the chicken to push out the excess fat. Use a sharp knife to cut excess fat.
Put the chicken, oregano, cumin, lime juice, salt, and pepper in the bowl and mix well. Proceed to the next step or cover and refrigerate up to overnight.
Put the contents of the bowl in the baking pan and transfer to the oven.
Bake about 1 hour until cooked throughout and well browned.
Serve right away.

recipes.title: Braised Chicken Thighs with Spinach
recipes.description: Chicken thighs are cooked until golden brown then simmered in a rich onion, garlic, thyme, and rosemary sauce with tender spinach.
instructions: Heat frying pan over medium-high heat. Add 1 teaspoon oil. Add chicken, top side down. Cook about 8 minutes on each side, or until deeply browned. Remove the chicken to a dinner plate and set aside.
Reheat frying pan over medium heat. Add the onion, garlic, thyme, and rosemary. Cook about 5 minutes, until the onion is soft and golden. Return the chicken to the pan.
Add the water, and cover. Continue cooking for about 30 minutes.
Add frozen spinach and cook for about 10 minutes. Or, add the fresh spinach and cook about 2 minutes, until it wilts. Serve right away.

recipes.title: Baked Salmon with Herbs and Lemon
recipes.description: Roast your favorite seasonal veggies while baking this fish for a wonderful dinner any time of the year.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
If using frozen fish, thaw in refrigerator according to package directions.
Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
Separate (or cut) fish into 4 pieces. Place fish in a 13x9x2-inch baking pan.
Combine paprika, garlic and onion powders, pepper, oregano, and thyme in a small bowl.
Sprinkle herb mixture and lemon juice evenly over the fish. Then drizzle melted margarine on top.
Bake until fish flakes easily with a fork, about 20 to 25 minutes.

recipes.title: Apple Corn Chili
recipes.description: This quick-fixing chilli, with a base of sautéed, puréed red apples and yellow corn, is so thick and flavorful that you'd never know it's low in fat and sodium. We feature it with chicken, but it can be made vegetarian by omitting the chicken and bouillon and substituting water or vegetable stock.
instructions: In a stockpot, heat 1 tbsp. olive oil; add chicken and brown (about 5 minutes). Remove chicken from pan.
Heat remaining olive oil in same pot; add onions and garlic and sauté until soft.
Add corn and sauté until golden brown. Add apple, cumin, and cayenne pepper (if desired); cook about 3-4 minutes. Let cool about 5 minutes.
Set aside about 1 cup of mixture. Purée remainder in food processor or blender, adding a portion of water, if needed, and return to pot.
Add browned chicken, black beans, chillies, bouillon, and water. Bring to boil and simmer about 15 minutes. Chicken should be cooked to 165 ºF.
To serve, ladle soup in bowls and top with non-puréed portion of apple corn mixture.

recipes.title: Chicken Ratatouille
recipes.description: Chicken is added to this traditional vegetable dish of tomatoes, courgette, and aubergine for a hearty and satisfying meal.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Remove skin and fat from chicken and cut into 1-inch pieces
Heat oil in large non-stick frying pan. Add chicken and sauté about 3 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Add courgette, aubergine, onion, green pepper, and mushrooms. Cook about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add tomatoes, garlic, basil, parsley, and pepper; stir and continue cooking about 5 minutes, or until chicken is tender.

recipes.title: Baked Pork Chops
recipes.description: Green and red peppers top these festive pork chops.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Trim fat from pork chops. Place chops in a 13x9 inch baking pan.
Spread onion and peppers on top of chops. Sprinkle with pepper and salt. Refrigerate for 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F).
Cover pan and cook 30 minutes.
Uncover, turn chops and re-cover with onions and peppers, and continue cooking for an additional 15 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 65°C (145°F).
Garnish with fresh parsley.

recipes.title: Fried Rice with Chicken and Vegetables

Put vegetable mix and rice back in the pan and mix with scrambled eggs.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.description: Mushrooms and nutmeg make a delicious yogurt-based sauce for the pasta in this beef recipe.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Cut beef into 1-inch cubes. Heat 1 teaspoon oil in non-stick frying pan. Sauté onion for 2 minutes.
Add beef and sauté for additional 5 minutes. Turn to brown evenly. Remove from pan and keep hot.
Add remaining oil to pan; sauté mushrooms.
Add beef and onions to pan with seasonings.
Add beef broth and yogurt; gently stir in. Heat, but do not boil.
Serve with macaroni.

recipes.title: Fiesta Lettuce Wraps and Pepper Boats
recipes.description: Using peppers and lettuce for wraps is a fun way to increase vegetables on the plate. Lettuce leaves and mini peppers are perfect for a build-your-own Southwestern meal or as appetizers.
instructions: Slice peppers in half vertically. Arrange lettuce and 8 pepper halves on a serving platter.
Cook brown rice according to package directions.
To make salsa fresca , dice remaining pepper halves, tomato, and onion; mix with corn, garlic, jalapeño pepper, and 1/4 teaspoon salt.
Sprinkle both sides of tilapia filets with Southwest chipotle seasoning.

Heat 1 1/2 tablespoons rapeseed oil in a large nonstick frying pan over medium-high heat. Add fish to pan, and cook for 3 minutes on each side (cook fish until it is opaque, 145 ºF). Flake with a fork and place in a serving dish.
When rice is done, stir in remaining 1/2 tablespoon oil, juice from one lime, and ¼ tsp salt. Cut remaining lime into wedges.
To serve, set out pepper-lettuce platter, rice, fish, salsa fresca , sour cream, and lime, and let diners build their own boats and wraps

recipes.title: Four Layer Casserole
recipes.description: This dish can be baked in the oven or if you are short on time, pop it into the microwave. Use your favorite frozen or canned vegetables.

recipes.title: Cream of Broccoli Soup
recipes.description: This creamy soup makes a perfect lunch or dinner. Keep it healthy using fat-free milk and fresh or frozen broccoli.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken Hash
recipes.description: This dish combines flavorful vegetables with chicken and seasonings to make a tasty lunch or dinner main dish.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Shred the potato and set aside. (It will darken in color, but this will not affect hash.)

Heat 1 tablespoons butter or oil in a medium/large non-stick frying pan. Add onion, peppers, celery and garlic. Sauté until lightly browned, 5 minutes. Push vegetables to one side of pan. Add remaining butter or oil. Add potatoes and mix with oil to coat them. Mix and combine well with the vegetables. Cook 3 minutes. If potatoes stick, scrape pan vigorously and move contents around pan to spray the bottom with cooking spray.

Mix in chicken, milk, cayenne, salt and pepper. Spread and flatten out the mixture into a thick cake. Use the edge of a pancake turner to cut it into 4 sections. (Or, hash can be broken into rough pieces while cooking.) Cover the pan. Cook until potatoes are tender and hash is lightly browned, 3 to 5 minutes, turning so bottom sides can also brown. (Spray pan with oil spray if necessary while turning hash.)

When hash is done, divide equally among four plates. Serve with barbecue sauce drizzled on top or around each portion. (If desired, sauce can first be thinned, by mixing 4 tablespoons sauce with 4 tablespoons milk.)

recipes.title: Egg Foo Young
recipes.description: Make these egg patties with chicken or beef and top them off with a homemade sauce for an easy Chinese dinner. Serve with brown rice and a salad for a complete and delicious meal.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Beat eggs with electric mixer (or by hand) until very thick and light, about 5 minutes.
Fold in bean sprouts, chicken or beef, mushrooms, and onion.
Heat oil in frying pan over moderate heat.
Pour egg mixture by half cupsful into the pan. Brown on one side; turn and brown the other side. Keep warm while preparing the sauce.
Mix sauce ingredients in small saucepan until smooth.
Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Serve sauce over patties.

recipes.title: Brussel Sprouts, Cranberry, and Bulgur Salad
recipes.description: Step up your salad game with this delicious dish, perfect for a gathering of friends or an easy lunch. Try substituting sunflower or pumpkin seeds for a nut-free option.
instructions: Wash hands with soap and water.
Cover bulgur with boiling water and let stand until soft, about 30 minutes. Pour off any excess water.
Rinse and trim Brussels sprouts. Cut in half lengthwise then slice crosswise into thin strips.
In a large bowl combine bulgur, Brussels sprouts, cranberries and nuts.
In a small bowl or jar with a lid, combine orange juice, oil, vinegar, salt and pepper. Mix or shake well. Pour dressing over salad and serve.

recipes.title: Corn Soup
recipes.description: This popular soup is sure to please any hungry stomach.
instructions: In a large pot, brown beef mince over medium to high heat for 8 to 10 minutes. Drain off fat.
Add water, corn kernels, cream style corn, onion, garlic, chilli powder, salt, and pepper to pot. Mix well.
Cook over low heat for about 15 minutes. Serve hot.
